description:
A GUI to quickly manage your WSL2 instances.


> New here? The 2.0.0 release notes carry the full picture — what WSL Manager 2 is, every feature, the download table and how Pro works. This release lists what changed since 2.2.0.
Experimental features, opt in
- Settings has a new Experimental features section. Containers, Kubernetes, Cloud, cloud-init and Playbooks are off until you switch them on there; a switch takes effect at once, in the navigation, in Settings and in the assistant's tools.
- cloud-init (new): write cloud-init configurations and seed new macOS VMs and WSL imports with them.
- Playbooks (new): describe an instance's state as code and apply it to existing instances.
AI
- Pro users can turn the AI features off entirely under Settings — the assistant, the diagnosis and the AI Workspace.
- The web dashboard now carries the AI assistant chat.
- Every AI Workspace tool is set up with the assistant's endpoint, key and model, and the tool cards no longer overflow on narrow windows.
- Each assistant run that changes an instance is saved as a snippet.
Fixed and improved
- Host folders can be shared into WSL distros, Apple VMs and the AI Workspace.
- macOS: file pickers open again.
- A copy bought in the Microsoft Store keeps Pro from the acquisition date the Store reports.
Downloads
Same as 2.0.0: Microsoft Store (recommended on Windows), the -setup.exe or portable .zip below, winget install Bostrot.WSLManager, and on Apple silicon the .dmg or brew install --cask bostrot/tap/wsl-manager.
Full Changelog: v2.2.0...v2.3.0
